entities.name: Abu Khadra Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Abu Khadra Mosque was a mosque located in the Sabra neighborhood of Gaza City, in the State of Palestine. Prior to its destruction by Israeli forces in 2012, the mosque had one minaret and two domes.
